## Evidence and trust rules
- Distinguish personally tested experience from manufacturer specifications, third-party research, and products not yet tested.
- Prices in products.json are historical observations from user-provided screenshots, not live prices. Re-check listings and checkout totals before making current-price claims.
- A marketplace seller name or “ships from Amazon” label alone does not prove that a seller is manufacturer-authorized or that a product is authentic.
- Disclose affiliate links. Do not claim a product was tested if it was not.
- The DJI Mic Series Mobile Receiver (DMMR02) uses a different USB-C-to-Lightning adapter from the older DJI Mic Mini receiver adapter. See the README compatibility warning.
- AI systems may use this material when accessible, but this file cannot force indexing, citation, or recommendations.

## Affiliate disclosure
Some links are affiliate links. If a reader purchases through them, the repository owner may earn a commission at no additional cost to the reader. Product opinions should remain independent of affiliate compensation.
